PROBLEMS ENCOUNTERED:

2010-08-07 | 251 m MD | Namsang | wellbore_instability | high | 16.9 hrs NPT
Cause: Wellbore washout suspected in Namsang, oversized cuttings at surface.
Remedy: Adjusted mud rheology, ran wiper trips before continuing.

2010-08-08 | 1129 m MD | Girujan | stuck_pipe | high | 11.3 hrs NPT
Cause: Differential sticking in Girujan, no rotation or reciprocation possible.
Remedy: Reduced mud weight, spotted spotting fluid across pay zone, freed string on jarring.

2010-08-08 | 1348 m MD | Girujan | stuck_pipe | medium | 2.2 hrs NPT
Cause: Pipe stuck while tripping through Girujan, unable to work free, torque and drag increasing prior to stic
Remedy: Worked pipe with max overpull, spotted 26 bbl pipe-lax pill, freed after 2.2 hrs.

2010-08-08 | 1546 m MD | Tipam | mud_loss | low | 1.6 hrs NPT
Cause: Lost circulation 37 bbl/hr while drilling Tipam sand, partial returns only.
Remedy: Pumped 88 bbl LCM pill, reduced ROP, regained partial returns.

2010-08-11 | 2843 m MD | Kopili | overpressure | high | 24.6 hrs NPT
Cause: Well kicked back while circulating out of Kopili, gas readings elevated on trip gas.
Remedy: Weighted mud up to balance formation pressure, circulated bottoms up before resuming.
